## Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe clearly (e.g., "I want the agent to support multi-modal post evaluation...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it should be implemented.

## Architectural & Human-in-the-Loop Impact
- [ ] Does this proposed feature preserve mandatory human approval for all write actions?
- [ ] Does it respect deterministic safety checks (circuit breakers, rate limits, TTLs)?
- [ ] Does it maintain typed LangGraph state workflows?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
